# MI450/gfx1250 P1 operator selectors: 260 nodes.
#
# Bounded from the P1 candidate files after a full gfx1250 A0 triage; every
# node passed on MI455X A0 with ROCm 10.2. Each line is an exact selector and
# its node count; a parametrized node ID selects exactly one node. Same review
# rule as the P0 manifest.
#
# Left out, with reasons (known failures are tracked in
# mi450-gfx1250-known-failures.txt):
#   test_unified_attention.py: one 3D case never completes and holds the GPU
#     (#7776); 4851 nodes otherwise.
#   test_pa_decode_sparse.py fp8, v4-unified, with_extra: wrong at kv_len=136
#     and on every eligible with_extra case (#7777).
#   test_gemm_afp4wfp4.py preshuffled split-K: KeyError NUM_BUFFERS (#7778).
#     The afp4_wfp4 Gluon cases are disabled on gfx1250; a bounded Triton set
#     is in.
#   test_mla.py NVFP4 unshuffled and Gluon-over-2GB: skip by design on gfx1250.
#   test_f4gemm.py, test_mxfp8fp4gemm.py, test_mla_decode_pagesize64.py,
#     test_pa_decode_bf16_asm.py: gfx1250 ASM kernels are B0-only; on A0 they
#     raise instead of skipping (#7779).
#   test_mhc.py, test_inverse_rope_group_quant.py: benchmark scripts, not
#     runnable as pytest (#7780).

# Triton MLA (Gluon on gfx1250): prefill and decode pipeline contracts.
